title: i got so drunk
lines: Wait—please tell me I'm not the only person who has looked at a Friday evening and made a completely catastrophic series of decisions.
Because last weekend, two of my college friends came over to my place, and we convinced ourselves we were going to have a chill, responsible night.

We got ready, put on our outfits, and then someone pulled out two full bottles of vodka for the pre-game. Two bottles. For three people. We looked at each other and went: 'Yeah, totally reasonable start.'
So we pack up our questionable life choices and head over to ADB's place. Suddenly we're six people crammed into his living room, absolutely starving.
We do what any civilized group does at eight p.m.: order an ungodly mountain of Chinese takeout, open the containers on the coffee table, and start pouring vodka shots.
Between the noodles and dumplings, the shots kept multiplying. ADB was sitting there looking calm while the rest of us were slowly ascending to another dimension.
And that is when someone brought out Pictionary. If you've never played Pictionary while completely blasted... do not do it.
I tried to draw a horse. It looked like an aggressively depressed potato with legs. Someone screamed 'toaster!' We argued for ten straight minutes.
By eleven, someone yelled: 'WE HAVE TO GO CLUBBING!' And when you're drunk, your brain genuinely believes that every club is the greatest place on Earth.
We get inside, bass vibrating through the floor, and our immediate genius idea is... taking even MORE shots at the bar.
We hit the dance floor and danced like our rent was due tomorrow. Complete, shameless, chaotic energy. My hair was a disaster.
At three a.m., exhausted and half-deaf, we somehow made it back to our friend's house. Normal humans would sleep. Not us. We booted up games and played all night on the carpet.
And right around five in the morning... the vodka finally collected its debt. The room started spinning like a carousel.
I sprinted to the bathroom, hugged the cold porcelain bowl for dear life, and violently lost every single noodle from dinner.
I collapsed into bed at sunrise and woke up twelve hours later feeling like a steamroller had backed over my skull. ...Anyway. Ten out of ten night. Never doing it again.
